objective: Select the next measurement goal after the paged-attention/KV-cache correctness and single-run timing evidence was refreshed into the public benchmark pack.
long_term_goal: Keep hybrid execution close to Verilator usage while making LLM-serving-like RTL workload correctness, speed trends, reproduction commands, and non-claims easy to regenerate and review.

options_reviewed.reason: The paged-attention/KV-cache scale-up measurement now has correctness and single-run timing in the public pack. The weakest remaining evidence gap is timing stability: the current ratios are useful directional observations, but they are not repeat-median evidence.
options_reviewed.weakness: This still measures the existing RTL harnesses and does not add production paged attention, production KV-cache memory hierarchy, or model-level Transformer inference.

options_reviewed.reason: Runtime optimization is valuable, but changing launch or resident behavior before stabilizing the paged-attention/KV-cache timing evidence would mix measurement confidence with implementation changes.
options_reviewed.weakness: Deferring keeps the known single-state repeated-launch weakness unresolved for now.

options_reviewed.reason: The current four-shape scale-up boundary already passed correctness and has single-run timing. Adding more shapes before repeat-median timing would broaden scope before closing confidence on the existing set.
options_reviewed.weakness: Leaves larger page counts, slot counts, and batch sizes outside the immediate next gate.

options_reviewed.reason: Quantized KV-cache is a relevant modern-serving extension, but it should follow stable repeat-median timing for the unquantized paged-attention/KV-cache baseline.
options_reviewed.weakness: Quantized serving memory behavior remains outside the active measurement.

options_reviewed.reason: Full ITA/MHA already has fresh generic-host-probe and historical resident/repeat evidence. More MHA shapes would add breadth but would not close the newest paged-attention/KV-cache timing confidence gap.
options_reviewed.weakness: May leave some attention-compute shape coverage unexpanded while focusing on serving-state harnesses.

selected_next_goal.name: paged_attention_kv_cache_repeat_median_timing
selected_next_goal.first_gate_objective: Define a repeat-median timing measurement boundary for the existing reviewed paged-attention/KV-cache four-shape set without changing runtime, ABI, workload, or correctness policy.
scope: reuse the four reviewed shapes from config/scaling_gates/paged_attention_kv_cache_timing_summary_gate.json
preserve coverage_output_equivalence as the correctness policy
record repeat count and median CPU, hybrid wall, and GPU-kernel timing fields
keep generated reports and artifacts non-canonical
do not import unreviewed candidate overlays
do not claim production paged attention, production KV-cache hierarchy, model-level Transformer inference, or production LLM-serving throughput

non_claims: not a runtime or ABI change
not broad speedup for arbitrary RTL
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
